This is a list of file signatures, data used to identify or verify the content of a file.
Such signatures are also known as magic numbers or Magic Bytes.
Many file formats are not intended to be read as text.
If such a file is accidentally viewed as a text file, its contents will be unintelligible.
However, sometimes the file signature can be recognizable when interpreted as text.
The column ISO 8859-1 shows how the file signature appears when interpreted as text in the common ISO 8859-1 encoding, with unprintable characters represented as ..
